title: Ghost
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ghostGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8d8ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a1040'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2a70'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ghost body -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q30 22 50 22 Q70 22 70 55 L70 78 Q65 72 60 78 Q55 84 50 78 Q45 72 40 78 Q35 84 30 78 Z'
        fill='url(#ghostGlow)' stroke='#b8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Ghost highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='5.5' ry='7' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40.5' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='46' rx='5.5' ry='7' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56.5' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a2a70'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ff9ec0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb0d0' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb0d0' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='60' r='2' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Sparkle crosses -->
  <path d='M76 24 L78 24 M77 23 L77 25' stroke='#ffffdd' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M22 48 L24 48 M23 47 L23 49' stroke='#ffffdd' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
